comparison.objective: Tighten a tourniquet windlass until a gauge reaches the green region and lock the rod; the candidate adjusts a damper until repeated carriage stops are acceptable and locks the setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Both test closed-loop rotary adjustment against resistance, regrasping or bimanual handoff, reading physical response, and mechanically locking the achieved setting. Candidate additionally requires recessed hex-key use and bounded setscrew torque; the record requires snapping a rod into a clip.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires at least 250 mmHg, the rod locked, and robot clearance for one second. Candidate requires two consecutive safe impacts, physical relocking, and a witness-torque drift check.
comparison.reason: Despite different equipment, both centrally test response-guided rotary tightening followed by retention of the target setting, including bimanual management of stored restoring force. The candidate adds fastener tooling and cyclic impact diagnosis, but these extend a substantially shared tested ability. Candidate leaves drift, rebound, and overload thresholds undeclared.
